_comment: V3 strategy configuration. Every value is traceable to a measured result in V3_ANALYSIS.md. Change nothing here without re-running the walk-forward analysis.

signal._comment: Fade short-term momentum. In the 9-month walk-forward sweep the '_inv' (fade) family dominated the P&L leaderboard; the follow-the-move ('_mom') family did not.
signal._evidence: pooled out-of-sample accuracy 0.5519 over 2,301 trades / 237 days / 8 folds; 7 of 8 folds above 0.50; worst fold 0.4783
signal._frequency_note: threshold 2.0 gives ~9.7 trades/day. Raising it to 2.5 cuts to ~2-6/day with slightly higher accuracy but a much smaller sample per fold.

risk._comment: V3 holds to settlement. The barrier study could not justify anything tighter: results swung between +0.09 and -0.20 per share across defensible intra-window path models, so the tight-TP/SL choice was model artifact, not edge.
risk._catastrophe_note: 0.35 is not an edge optimisation. It bounds the loss on a position that is already deeply wrong. At 0.35 the barrier is only reachable when the position has lost nearly all value.

sizing._comment: 2% of equity per position. With a real edge of 3 points and 10 trades/day, sizing above this turns normal variance into ruin.

execution._comment: The gate that decides whether V3 may trade at all. See V3_README.md for the full ladder.
execution._max_entry_evidence: break-even accuracy at entry p is p + 0.07*p*(1-p). Pooled accuracy 0.5519 breaks even at p = 0.535. Above that the trade is negative EV regardless of the signal.
execution._slippage_evidence: at +1c slippage 7/8 folds were profitable; at +3c the pooled edge is +0.0059/share; beyond ~+4c it is negative.
execution._require_fill_note: V3 refuses to trade on a modelled price. Until real fills are observed, it records the gap instead. This is the sim-vs-live gap made operational.

fees._comment: fee per share = coefficient * p * (1-p). Settlement is not a trade and carries no exit fee.

safety._comment: V3 ships paper-only. live_trading_enabled must be flipped deliberately, and the execution gate above must have measured fills behind it.
